12630.html:
12630 śōdháyati 'purifies' TS., 'removes anything obnoxious' Mn. [√śudh]
    Pa. sōdhēti 'cleans, clears, pays (a debt), searches for'; Pk. sōhēi 'cleans, searches'; NiDoc. śodheyiṣyasi 'you will pay off', śodhitavo; S. soiṇu 'to weed, clean pipe of hookah'; WPah.jaun. śōaṇō̃ 'to brush'; Bi. sohab 'to weed', H. sohnā; G. sɔ̃vũ 'to sift, winnow'; Si. soyanavā, ho° 'to seek'. — Caus.: Pk. sōhāvēi 'causes to be cleaned'; Gy. eur. šulav- 'to sweep, wel. šuvel f. 'broom'.

12629.html:
12629 śōdhana 'cleaning' Mn., n. Nir., śōdhanī- f. 'broom' lex. [√śudh]
    Pa. sōdhana- n. 'cleaning, payment (of a debt)'; Pk. sōhaṇa- 'purifying', °ṇī- f. 'broom'; Ash. sōnə 'brush, broom'; S. soiṇī f. 'long pricker for cleaning pipe of hookah'; P.ludh. sūhnī f. 'broom', WPah.jaun. śuain; Bi. sohan 'coarse rasp', sŏhnī 'weeding'; Mth. sohen 'coarse rasp'; Bhoj. sohanī 'weeding'; H. sohnī, sonī f. 'broom'.
    Addenda: śōdhana-: WPah.kṭg. śv̄̃ṇ (w. high level tone) f. (obl. -i) 'broom', J. śū̃hṇ f. (x *śudhati?).
